interface.name: serenity_input_capture_manager_v1
interface.description: The manager global. One per compositor; only offered when input capture is enabled for the session.

request.name: create_session
request.description: Create a session for the application identified by app_id. The session is inert until further requests are made on it.

interface.name: serenity_input_capture_session_v1
interface.description: Per-application input-capture session. May be destroyed at any time; the compositor tears down any associated EIS client.

request.name: connect_to_eis
request.description: Ask the compositor for the session's EIS implementation file descriptor. The compositor replies with the eis_fd event; the fd is passed to a libei receiver context (ei_setup_backend_fd). May be called once.
